title: Boba Fett's Rancor
subtitle: Emotionally Complex Creature
text:
When Played: Deal 5 damage to your base. Then, deal 5 damage to an enemy ground unit. Then, deal 5 damage to the same unit.
On Attack: You may deal 1 damage to a base for every 5 damage on your base.
rules:
(ERRATA) On Attack: Choose a base. You may deal 1 damage to it for every 5 damage on your base.
Boba Fett's Rancor's ""When Played"" ability deals 2 instances of damage to a unit. If both instances of damage are dealt to a unit with a Shield token, the Shield will only prevent the first damage.
